prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-resolution landscape design comparison board for ALDA CONNECT, a premium fitness and health web app, with one spacious desktop trainer dashboard on the left and two complete portrait mobile client screens on the right, one light mode and one dark mode. Flat crisp UI, no browser window, no desk scene. All app text in Bosnian, readable and concise. Fictional demonstration only. Desktop trainer Alda: navigation Pregled, Klijenti, Planovi, Kalendar, Poruke; title "Dobar dan, Alda"; useful task queue showing "Amrudin · Pregled sedmice", "Plan treninga", and button "Pozovi klijenta". Show a clean weekly calendar and client activity list. Mobile client Amrudin: heading "Tvoj dan", prominent "Trening snage", "5 vježbi · 45 min", button "Započni trening"; secondary Ishrana, Oporavak, Moj tim, and "Testni nalaz · Čeka pregled". Bottom navigation Danas, Plan, Napredak, Poruke, Više. Usable thumb-sized controls, disciplined hierarchy, precise typography and ample space, credible fully working product aesthetic. Avoid clinical claims, invented outcomes, real health values, oversized decorative empty panels, excessive metrics, gold gradients or ornamental luxury logos.  Board title at top: "05 — PRIVATE HEALTH CLUB". Visual direction: understated expensive private health club. Warm ivory and deep espresso grounds, muted bronze used sparingly for actions, elegant editorial serif only for main greetings with exceptionally clean sans-serif for all controls. Generous quiet surfaces and fine dividers, restrained rounded corners. Dark mode espresso with warm legible text. One strong membership-card-inspired daily workout panel; ordinary familiar app controls throughout. Feel discreet, personal, meticulously crafted, never hotel booking UI.
